description: Add an index entry (Registereintrag): topic as a path of 1 to 4 levels (missing levels are created), sort_as (sort key per level). Where it points: a text range of a story (frame_id with start_index and optional end_index, indices as get_frame_text) or find_text – every occurrence in the document or, with frame_id, in that story (case_sensitive, whole_word, max_matches default 100; text of tables of contents and indexes is skipped). page_reference_type current_page (default), to_next_style_change, to_next_use_of_style (limit_paragraph_style), to_end_of_story, to_end_of_section, to_end_of_document, for_next_paragraphs or for_next_pages (limit_count), suppress_page_numbers; page_number_style overrides the character style of the page number. cross_reference {type see (default) | see_also | see_or_see_also | see_herein | see_also_herein | custom | custom_before | custom_after, topic (path, created if missing), custom_text} adds a "see" reference instead of or besides the page reference. A page reference inserts an invisible marker character before its source, so story indices behind it shift by one. Stories that are locked by an editorial workflow (lock_state) are refused (story_locked) or, with find_text, skipped (skipped_locked). Returns topic, index_created, created_topics[] (paths), page_references[] {page_reference_id, type, page_id, page_name, frame_id, story_id, index, in_overset}, page_reference_count, matches_found, skipped_locked, cross_reference. Then generate_index.

cross_reference.description: "See" reference from topic to another topic.

topic.description: Topic as a path of 1 to 4 levels, top level first, e.g. ["Fruit", "Apples"].

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

end_index.description: End of the range (exclusive). Default start_index (a text position).

find_text.description: Mark every occurrence of this text.

frame_id.description: Text frame of the story: with start_index the range, with find_text limits the search to this story.

limit_count.description: for_next_paragraphs / for_next_pages: number of paragraphs or pages.

limit_paragraph_style.description: to_next_use_of_style: the paragraph style that ends the range (default: the style of the entry paragraph).

max_matches.description: find_text: at most this many page references (default 100).

page_number_style.description: Character style for this page number.

page_reference_type.description: Page range of the reference. Default current_page.

sort_as.description: Sort key per level ("" keeps the topic name).

start_index.description: First character of the range in the story.

topic.description: Topic as a path of 1 to 4 levels, top level first, e.g. ["Fruit", "Apples"].

whole_word.description: find_text: whole words only. Default false.

name: add_index_entry
title: Add an index entry
